bug_info.bug_desc: When RdataMuxCheck is enabled, the read data outputs for both ports use a hardcoded zero constant ('0) instead of the configurable WordZeroVal parameter when reading from register x0. This causes incorrect data to be returned for x0 reads when WordZeroVal is configured to a non-zero value, leading to ECC check failures when RegFileECC is enabled.
bug_info.fix_hint: Replace the hardcoded '0 constant with the WordZeroVal parameter in the conditional assignments for rdata_a_o and rdata_b_o within the gen_rdata_mux_check block.

bug_info.fix_hint: Replace the hardcoded '0 constant with the WordZeroVal parameter in the conditional assignment for rdata_a_o within the gen_no_rdata_mux_check block.
